reviews.title: Nice but stiff
reviews.review_text: I like that it has the suction cups on the sides of the curtain as I have a fiberglass or acrylic tub/shower combo. I did not like that it is VERY STIFF. When you open or close the curtain it sometimes comes out of the grommet hooks at the top of curtain and it is hard to keep open to clean out tub when done with your shower.

reviews.title: Not what was pictured
reviews.review_text: The liner is good quality, it's not what was pictured. I ordered soft silver and the image was like a clear silver frosty look, no the liner that came was opaque and gray. It's ok it will work this time but I won't purchase again, and buyer be ware that you might get something different than pictured.

reviews.title: Heavyweight and very stiff
reviews.review_text: I don't mind it, but I gave one to my mom and she had me remove hers. It is very thick and very stiff. They are elderly and she thought it would make them fall. Mine has been up for a few weeks and is still super stiff. My husband says it should last a lifetime. lol

Material is good quality. Very thick and sturdy. The problem is it is too stiff. You can't slide it open. It won't bunch up like it should. So you peel it back and climb in the tub/shower. Never seen anything like it.

reviews.title: Heavy Shower Curtain
reviews.review_text: It is a heavy liner and very stiff at first. It is long enough and does the job I need it to do. It is washable I'd say a couple times. Then usually replace it.
